tasks.title: Clamp both bounds
tasks.task: Fix bounded.py so clamp(value, lower, upper) rejects lower greater than upper and always clamps values to both inclusive bounds. Keep the public API unchanged and edit only bounded.py. Verification is evaluator-owned; return no verification commands.

tasks.hidden_evaluator:
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
from bounded import clamp
assert clamp(99, 0, 10) == 10
assert clamp(-9, -4, 7) == -4
try:
    clamp(1, 3, 2)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('inverted bounds were accepted')

tasks.title: Validate chunk sizes
tasks.task: Fix chunks.py so chunks(items, size) keeps returning lists for valid positive integer sizes, but raises ValueError for zero, negative, boolean, or non-integer sizes. Keep the public API unchanged and edit only chunks.py. Verification is evaluator-owned; return no verification commands.

initial_files.README.md:
# Chunks

`chunks` splits a sequence into lists of a requested positive integer size.
initial_files.chunks.py:
def chunks(items, size):
    return [list(items[index:index + size]) for index in range(0, len(items), size)]
